name: V. Y. Mudimbe
shortBio: Congolese philosopher and philologist whose landmark archaeology of the "colonial library" exposed how European anthropology and theology constructed Africa as an epistemic Other.
centralQuestion: How can African philosophy speak authentically when the very categories used to define "Africa" were forged inside the colonial library?

keyWorks.title: The Invention of Africa: Gnosis, Philosophy, and the Order of Knowledge
keyWorks.description: Foucauldian archaeology of Africanist discourse distinguishing colonial gnosis from autonomous African philosophical practice.

keyWorks.title: The Idea of Africa
keyWorks.description: Traces Greek, Roman, and modern European textual constructions of Africa alongside African counter-memory.
